title: A Spiking Neural Model of the Mental Lexicon: Representations, Similarity Structure, and Associative Retrieval in Perception and Production
abstract: arXiv:2611.09402v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A neural account of lexical access requires an explicit distinction between the structure of lexical representations, the associations linking representational levels, and the activity generated during retrieval. This paper specifies a spiking neural implementation of the mental lexicon within the Neural Engineering Framework and Semantic Pointer Architecture. Conceptual and phonological form representations are constructed recursively from relational graphs, whereas lemma representations provide independent lexical identities. The implementation contains 613 lexical entries and supports two directed processing pathways: perception maps a phonological form to its associated concept via a lemma, whereas production maps a concept to its associated phonological form via a lemma. translated_title: 心理词典的脉冲神经网络模型：知觉与产生中的表征、相似性结构与联想提取
translated_abstract: 词汇通达的神经学解释需要明确区分词汇表征的结构、连接各表征层次的关联关系，以及提取过程中产生的活动。本文在神经工程框架和语义指针架构内给出了心理词典的脉冲神经网络实现。概念表征和语音形式表征由关系图递归构建，而引理表征则提供独立的词汇身份。该实现包含613个词汇条目，并支持两条有向处理通路：知觉通路通过引理将语音形式映射到其关联的概念，产生通路通过引理将概念映射到其关联的语音形式。每条通路结合了两种联想记忆变体——胜者全取（WTA）选择（竞争）和阈值传递——并使用199,400个泄漏积分发放神经元……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在神经工程框架内构建了一个包含613个词汇条目的脉冲神经网络心理词典模型，通过引理中介支持知觉（语音到概念）和产生（概念到语音）两条处理通路，并结合胜者全取竞争与阈值传递两种联想记忆机制来模拟词汇通达。
